control.note: harness overhead baseline: no real icon extraction, fixed buffer

addon.note: in-process N-API; startupMs is one-time module load (measured during the cold-baseline phase above); per-icon stats here are warm-cache steady-state

koffi.note: in-process koffi FFI, dll-load+CoInitializeEx+first-call cost measured separately

pwsh.note: median/p95 are PER-REQUEST round-trip latency at concurrency=4, EXCLUDING timed-out requests (a timeout measures the timeout constant, not the bridge); successRate's denominator is total attempts (successes+failures incl. timeouts), not sample count; aggregateThroughputMsPerIcon is wall-clock/app-count and is the number comparable to a single-icon-at-a-time cost

coldBaseline.note: bridge-agnostic: measured with the N-API addon exactly once, before any candidate loop, because Windows' thumbcache is keyed by file not by bridge
